Kashi Vishwanath Temple Gold Dome Reports Declared False

Reports claiming gold was missing from the Kashi Vishwanath Temple dome have been declared false by the Divisional Commissioner. The Wire reported on the incident, questioning whether the gold was stolen or dropped by monkeys.
